# langsmith_agent (Resource)

Manages a LangSmith agent. Its environments and tracing projects are created automatically.

Deleting or replacing an agent deletes its environments and can also delete associated runtimes, tracing projects, and traces.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "langsmith_agent" "example" {
  agent_id    = "example"
  name        = "Example Agent"
  source_type = "EXTERNAL"

  # Omit to use the workspace configured on the provider.
  workspace_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}

output "production_tracing_project_id" {
  value = langsmith_agent.example.environments["PRODUCTION"].tracer_session_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) Unique agent ID within the workspace. Changing it replaces the agent.

### Optional

- `agent_type` (String) Classification: CUSTOM or CODING. Defaults to CUSTOM on create; omission preserves an existing value. Changes require workspace settings management permission.
- `name` (String) Display name. Defaults to agent_id on create; when omitted on an existing agent, preserves its current value.
- `source_type` (String) Runtime kind. Defaults to EXTERNAL on create; omission preserves an existing value. Only EXTERNAL agents without runtime bindings can change source type. Unsupported transitions fail without replacing the agent.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace override. When omitted, resolves the provider workspace and saves it in state. Changing it replaces the agent.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Agent creation timestamp.
- `environments` (Map of Object) Visible environments keyed by LOCAL, DEVELOPMENT, STAGING, or PRODUCTION. Existing agents may have fewer environments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments))
- `id` (String) Public agent ID, equal to agent_id.
- `owner_id` (String) Owner user ID, when present.

<a id="nestedatt--environments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environments`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `tracer_session_id` (String)
- `tracer_session_name` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import langsmith_agent.example example
# Specify a workspace override when importing from another workspace.
terraform import langsmith_agent.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/example
```
